name: design-studio-ai
title_zh: 设计稿从草稿到发布，全程不换工具的 CLI 工作室
tagline_zh: 在终端里创建、检查、打磨、导出、发布结构化网页设计、幻灯片、报告、线框、3D 场景与时间线项目。
tagline_en: Create, inspect, refine, export & publish structured web designs, slides, reports, wireframes, 3D scenes &.
desc_en: Create, inspect, refine, export, and publish structured web designs, slides, reports, wireframes, 3D scenes, and timeline projects in Design Studio AI through its CLI or authenticated MCP tools.
why_zh: 不是画布，是结构化设计引擎。每个元素都可编程审查与批量修改。
why_en: Not a canvas — a structured design engine. Every element is inspectable & batch-editable via code; MCP lets AI read & modify.
limit_zh: 只认 Design Studio AI 的项目格式，不兼容 Figma/Sketch 源文件。
limit_en: Only Design Studio AI project format; no Figma/Sketch import. Local renderer needed for PDF/screenshots (e.g. Chromium). 3D limited to built-in.
title_en: A CLI studio for web design, slides, 3D & timelines
